{{External|rs|rsc=Black Short Sword|dw=Black Sword}} {{Infobox Item |name = Black sword |image = [[File:Black sword.png]] |release = [[8 December]] [[2001]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (8 December 2001) |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wield, Drop |examine = A razor sharp sword. |value = 624 |weight = 1.814 |exchange = Yes |id = 1283 }} [[File:Black sword detail.png|left|100px]] The '''black sword''' is a low-mid level [[weapon]] made of [[black equipment|black]], which is stronger than [[steel equipment|steel]]. It requires level 10 [[Attack]] to wield. As with all black equipment, it offers the same bonuses as [[white equipment]], minus the [[prayer bonus]]. Similarly, it cannot be smithed using the [[Smithing]] skill. It can be obtained from various monsters including [[cyclops]], [[abyssal demon]]s, and [[black demon]]s, or bought from the [[Varrock Swordshop]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = +14 |aslash = +10 |acrush = -2 |amagic = 0 |arange = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = +2 |dcrush = +1 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = +12 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = weapon |speed = 4 |attackrange = 1 |combatstyle = Stab Sword |image = [[File:Black sword equipped male.png|155px]] |altimage = [[File:Black sword equipped female.png|150px]] }} {{CombatStyles|Stab Sword|speed=4|attackrange=1}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Black sword}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Black sword}} ==Changes== ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Black sword detail (beta).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Black sword detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Black sword (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Black sword.png|center]] |- |RuneScape 2
